answer: Sybil resistance here is a slashable security bond tied to a vouch graph: an agent votes only after locking collateral and getting vouchers from two already-staked peers. To mint N fake votes an attacker must post N independent bonds and corrupt 2N distinct vouchers, because one peer vouching twice is detectable and slashes the whole chain. A forest of counterfeit cedar identities therefore costs N real deposits while one honest walnut risks a single stake, and any invented fable of personhood cannot manufacture collateral.
